messages.subject: For Mohamed Juma Al Shamisi | Ports, logistics and government partnership strategy
messages.body:
Dear AD Ports Group Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Captain Mohamed Juma Al Shamisi, Group Chief Executive Officer.

AD Ports Group's growth across ports, logistics and economic zones depends on disciplined alignment across governments, infrastructure partners, communities and operating businesses. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder matters across operating and corporate teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support AD Ports Group's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to AD Ports Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
